additional_info.subject: ID0446689-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002000]Intermittent Charging Issues CRM:02681000709
additional_info.body:
Hi Martin,
Me and Catalina checked all the sessions today and here are our findings:
For these charging sessions, it's not related to the Mercedes eActros, it's with the Volvo, where we see that the EV is not establishing the connection:
00.16.81.0e.e8.48
Since this is the only time where we have a problem with the Volvo, we will move forward to the main topic which is the eActros:
In the logs, all the failed sessions with Mercedes, this is the root cause, the EV is creating noise on the PilotState and changing from C (charging) to B (ready). All occur with this EV:
ec9468000d35
This topic is already under investigation from Mercedes, they acknowledged their problem which is caused by the Air pump.
We are working together to find a solution for this.
For the moment, we can enable the Wake up function via OCPP, I checked the configuration and it's not correct, from the backend the following configuration must be:
TxStopPoint=EnergyTransfer (default)
TxStopPoint=PowerPathClosed (correct one)
With the wakeup function, if the sessions fail, the truck restarts it by itself.
Let me know your feedback.
Have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco

Hello Martin, good morning :) I hope you had a nice weekend.
From our side it's ready. I just need you to reach out to your backend provider and ask them to change the configuration:

I will wait for your feedback.

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0446689-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002000]Intermittent Charging Issues CRM:02681000709
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
After some unexplained "incidence," we were no longer able to charge our Ivecos – they stayed unused for several weeks – with all the negative consequences for our logistics. As an outsider, it was difficult for us to distinguish between Iveco and Siemens...the result from the user's perspective was simple: the truck could not be used.
We've learned from this, of course. Currently, the charging processes are working quite reliably at D300 and D160. Therefore, we don't have necessity to adjust anything in the system.
We still have to discuss with our partner Energu, whether to update our public stations to V8. Some improvements to the SECC could improve availability and the charging experience for our customers.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Martin Glöckner
